decisions.reason: Turnaround management is core to the integrated airside strategy and has its own page, so it likely meets aspirations and the expanding firm has slack to keep investing in it.
The connectivity module underpins data integration across the apron, and with no evident shortfall and ample slack there is no trigger for problemistic search to cut it.
Billing software is the furthest from the core and only mentioned on the site, but with growth and slack the firm can carry it while its results remain uncertain.
Equipment monitoring uses the installed base and supports the lifecycle service direction at low resource cost, so keeping it is consistent with aspirations.
Resource management complements turnaround management closely, and a growing firm faces no shortfall that would push it to drop the module.
The safety alert service builds on tower and surveillance expertise and serves customers' safety goals, so absent a performance shortfall the firm keeps it.
